summary: Frontend-only mobile-web (390x844) smoke of the 4 reskinned Partner 'More' sub-pages via Partner Demo one-tap login. All target testIDs render, all backend endpoints return 200, no console errors and no red-box on any page. My Invoices: header 'My Invoices' + subtitle + partner chip (Raj Kumar), search filter narrows to empty state, invoice-filter/invoice-sort toggle reveals all 4 sort chips (sort-newest/oldest/amount_high/amount_low) — GET /api/invoices?range=all&sort=newest|oldest|7d fired 200; range chips (range-all/today/7d) re-fetch; horizontal INVOICES=11 / TOTAL AMOUNT=₹15,950.28 / PAID stat cards; pagination-info 'Showing 1–10 of 11 invoices' + page-next reaches page 2 '11–11' + page-size toggles 10↔25; invoice card testIDs `invoice-<uuid>` with inv-view (→ /partner/invoice/<id> detail page with Download PDF + Share Invoice buttons), inv-download (→ same detail w/ download=1), inv-more reveals inv-share-<id>. Earnings: blue hero '₹5.7K Total Earnings · 6 jobs completed' + WALLET BALANCE ₹1.53K box; 4 stat cards TODAY ₹2.28K / WEEK ₹2.28K / MONTH ₹3.18K / LIFETIME ₹5.7K; 'Earnings Trend' LineChart renders; 'Payout History' has 1 completed WD row (WD-484890 ₹490 UPI); 'Earnings Ledger · 6 transactions' with 6 rows `ledger-AZOxxxxxx`, tapping expands ledger-detail with Service Cost / Partner Commission / Platform Commission / Net earning + Date; Showing 1–6 of 6. Network 200: /wallet/partner/earnings, /partner/earnings-summary, /partner/withdrawals. Bank & KYC: blue hero 'Complete KYC to withdraw' + Pending pill + pending message + PAN Card / Bank Account chips + 0% KYC DONE ring; PAN Card card w/ Incomplete badge; pan-input uppercases 'abcde1234fzzzz' → 'ABCDE1234F' (length capped at 10); submit-pan aria-disabled=true when <10 chars, enabled at 10 (not submitted per instructions); 'Add bank' (add-bank) + empty state 'No bank accounts yet' with add-bank-empty both open the bottom sheet showing Account holder, Bank name, Account number, IFSC, UPI (optional), Passbook picker + 'Add bank account' (submit-bank) — closed without submitting. My Availability: light-blue info card w/ AVAILABLE DATES 4/7 progress bar; September 2026 calendar w/ S M T W T F S header, past days greyed, today (17) has blue ring, cal-prev/cal-next change month; 30 avail-YYYY-MM-DD cells rendered; tapped avail-2026-09-20 → POST /api/partner/availability/calendar/set (available) 200 → cell turned green 'Available' + counter 4→5; tapped again → POST (unavailable) 200 → cell turned red 'Not avail.' + counter reverted to 4 + toast 'Marked not available' visible in screenshot; legend row (Available/Not Available/Awaiting/Today) + 'Next available dates' list with next-YYYY-MM-DD rows. Back navigation from all 4 pages returns to Dashboard. No console errors, no red-box.

issues: 'Complete KYC to withdraw' wraps to 3 lines ('Complete KYC' / 'to withdraw') at 390px because the 56x56 shield icon + 78px progress ring flank a narrow middle column (~180px). Readable but visually cramped — consider a smaller icon or dropping the ring to a second row on <400px.

Only 2 of 3 stat cards (INVOICES / TOTAL AMOUNT) fit before scroll; PAID card requires horizontal swipe. Matches web spec (horizontal scroller) but the lack of a visual scroll cue may make users miss it — consider a subtle right-edge fade or peek.

critical_code_review_comments: payouts.tsx imports expo-image-picker; ImagePicker is used inside AddBankModal + PAN section — on Expo web the picker works but permission prompts throw noisy warnings. Consider guarding with Platform.OS !== 'web' fallback or web-native <input type=file>.

invoices.tsx: invoice-filter and invoice-sort both call setSortOpen((o) => !o) → identical behavior. Web parity says filter should toggle range/date filters instead; currently they are duplicate icons. Low-priority visual/UX issue.

availability.tsx: `cur === 'available' → mutate 'unavailable'`, but there is no path back to 'awaiting' from the UI. Comment in code acknowledges this — consider a long-press to clear or ensure backend supports 'awaiting' status for full parity.
earnings.tsx pagination footer shows a static '25/page' pill (non-interactive) — either remove the chevron or wire it to state to avoid confusing users.
seed_data_creation: None functional — availability toggled +1 day then reverted (same-day toggle leaves cell as 'unavailable' since API cannot restore 'awaiting'; picked 2026-09-20 which was awaiting).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Partner 'More' sub-pages (/partner/invoices, /partner/earnings, /partner/payouts, /partner/availability) fully validated on mobile web 390x844 with Partner Demo (Raj Kumar, +919000000003). All headers, testIDs, chips, stat cards, sort/range filters, pagination, detail expansion, and mutation POSTs work; all backend endpoints /api/invoices, /api/wallet/partner/earnings, /api/partner/earnings-summary, /api/partner/withdrawals, /api/partner/finance-kyc, /api/partner/finance-kyc/banks, /api/partner/availability/calendar, /api/partner/availability/calendar/set return 200. Left the demo partner with avail-2026-09-20 now 'unavailable' (was 'awaiting'). Did NOT submit PAN or add a bank per request.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in this iteration.
